scope: Research-only source-access and prioritization evidence for Jubilee Model Research & Calibration.

current_wqp_depth_audit.interpretation: The current WQP corpus is useful for shoreline/watershed context but cannot be treated as a robust bottom-oxygen or vertical-stratification panel. ADEM beach rows are 91.6% missing depth and the Alabama Water Watch Magnolia rows are 100% missing depth.

verified_source_access.high_value_history: Meaher Park hydro 2003-2025; Battleship Park hydro 2022-2025; Bon Secour hydro 2010-2025; Cedar Point hydro 2008-2025; Dauphin Island hydro 2003-2025; Katrina Cut and Perdido Pass hydro 2011-2025.
verified_source_access.guardrail: Native depth values still require deployment-geometry interpretation before any bottom-state promotion.

verified_source_access.sampling: near-monthly shipboard surveys with hydrographic profiles and water samples throughout Mobile Bay and adjacent shelf
verified_source_access.research_role: Long historical physical-state climatology and matched-control construction; monthly cadence is too coarse for lead-hour event timing.

verified_source_access.period: 2019-01-01 to 2019-12-16; hydrography available through 2019-07-03 due instrument failure
verified_source_access.sampling: hourly hydrography at different water-column depths
verified_source_access.research_role: Direct multi-depth stratification and hypoxic-layer persistence calibration.

verified_source_access.sampling: three moored CTD stations in Mobile Bay
verified_source_access.research_role: Direct in-bay summer oxygen/stratification state during the documented 2016 upwelling/downwelling study period.

datasets.title: CTD casting data along the ship channel of Mobile Bay, 2010-08-18 to 2010-10-27
ADCP transecting data along the ship channel of Mobile Bay

verified_source_access.research_role: Efficient in-bay observed hydrography/current validation path for NGOFS2 before larger offshore HFR ingestion.

verified_source_access.location: FOCAL mooring approximately 25 km southwest of Mobile Bay mouth
verified_source_access.research_role: Co-located shelf hydrography plus observed currents; preferred first boundary-condition validation dataset for NGOFS2.

verified_source_access.sampling: 0.5 m water-column bins, 5-minute averages every 20 minutes
verified_source_access.research_role: Vertical observed-current validation at FOCAL boundary site.

datasets.coverage: Mississippi Bight surface currents from Pascagoula, Orange Beach and Destin HFR stations
Mississippi Sound near-surface HFR velocities; surface 0.3-2.5 m depending on radar frequency/profile

verified_source_access.research_role: Secondary surface-current validation after smaller, more directly relevant in-bay/FOCAL observed-current datasets.

revised_ingestion_priority: 1. NCEI 0188979 2016 Mobile Bay moored CTDs plus related 2016 CTD casts: direct summer oxygen/stratification.
2. NCEI 0224293 Middle Bay 2019 multi-depth hydrography: direct vertical DO/salinity structure.
3. Mobile Bay ship-channel CTD+ADCP 2010: in-bay observed circulation/hydrography validation at about 109 MB total.
4. NCEI 0248354 FOCAL 2007-2016 current+hydrography and 0211052 AWAC: co-located shelf boundary validation.
6. Native ARCOS station-year history: recurrent regional DO/salinity/depth context after deployment-geometry reconciliation.
7. HFR archives: useful surface-current validation, but lower information-per-byte for Jubilee mechanism than direct in-bay/FOCAL datasets.
remaining_blockers: No newly recovered payload from the high-priority NCEI/DISL/GRIIDC archives has yet been parsed into the canonical feature panel in this run.
No direct Point Clear/Daphne bottom dissolved-oxygen observation is available for live production.
Zero verified matched clean controls remain; held-out forecast skill is not established.
ARCOS native depth values require deployment-geometry interpretation before bottom-state eligibility.
Observed-current versus NGOFS2 validation has not yet been scored; no model transport weight change is justified.
